description: Hypothesis: affine-8 group-64 staging improves prefill over the packed-FP8 reference (1952.9 tok/s). This is a new base because target_weights changes. Source FP8 matrices are decoded and requantized; the BF16 embedding and LM head are quantized too. The text cache omits unused vision weights and is mapped without load-time CPU repacking. Use --affine-cache with --tuned-prefill --delta-mode staged8, 2048-token blocks, fused experts, FP16 KV/operands, FP32 accumulation/state, DFlash2 with shared affine vocabulary matrices, and explicit 32768-token context. Run all seven Full-profile tests. Quantization, vocabulary storage and backing-file handling change together; this is a complete-system comparison, not decoder-only attribution. Cache manifest SHA-256: 7106f2aaaa4ada10f4f3a8512d1b5ecef83f8e271b542ad6549d56ff582b4974.
target_weights: Derived unsigned affine 8-bit, group size 64, BF16 scale/bias pairs (bootstrap-affine8-g64-v2); official FP8 matrices requantized and BF16 embedding/LM head quantized; other text BF16/FP32 tensors preserved; not the MLX checkpoint
